notes.title: Randy And Teddy Adventure Road 0.4.0 Release
notes.content:
Randy And Teddy Adventure Road 0.4.0 Release

Steam achievements work! :D Plus we've added a Leaderboard!

Let's build more interest about this awesome game and help Randy and Teddy pass all 25 levels! We can now finally see if someone achieves this, so later we can build more levels. We challenge you. It's a hardy hard game-o. HEHE

Updates:
- Fixed Steam Achievements
- Added Leaderboard

Coming Soon Forest Grump by Randy and Teddy!
